prompt: A full post with votes and author actions.
shortDesc: A full post (from GetPost post): board tag, title, author and age, body paragraphs, tags, vote control and comment count; when post.mine is true the author gets Edit and Delete.

props.name: post
props.description: GetPost → post: { id, boardId, title, body, tags, author: { displayName }, createdAt, edited, score, commentCount, myVote?, mine? }.

styling.notes: Archivo 800 28px title; 16px body lines capped near 64 characters; inline delete confirmation (no browser dialogs).

dependencies.usage: Vote control in the action bar.

interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'edit post', postId, title, body, outputFormat: { ok: 'boolean' } }
